notes: HHC in quest escrows is the ASIN-HHC network's issued utility credit for verified work (mesh ledger). Rewards are issued, not bought; no cash prizes, no price talk, no promises — proof only.

quests.settlement: Two independent verifiers re-fetch the claim and compare; PASS pays 90% to the winner, 10% split by verifiers (paid on any verdict). Verdict receipts are public either way.
quests.title: Seal the Index

quests.sponsor_terms: Whoever funds the pool names the quest theme (within the rules) and takes a permanent Sponsor row on the board. Escrow is created and receipted publicly before the quest is announced.
quests.title: Opens when funded

verified_rows.work: First verified payout on the GPU mesh — two independent computers checked the job, neither was the worker
First payout, verifier 1 of 2 — independent output-hash match
First payout, verifier 2 of 2 — separate hosted machine
Second-operator blind witness for the Verification Gate's first live PASS (provenance index seal)

challenges.title: Break the Gate
tracks: A: demonstrably false claim receives a gate PASS receipt
B: Proof Board row, gate receipt, or provenance-index entry does not recompute
challenges.settlement: Break confirmed by two independent verifiers reproducing it from the public record; PASS pays 90% to the breaker, 10% split by verifiers (paid on any verdict). Verdict receipts public either way.

services.name: Operated Agent — First Job
services.shape: One deliverable, written scope with 3-5 checkable acceptance criteria; delivery within 48h of scope sign-off (clock pauses at stop points/outages); 1 correction round included; PASS settles, FAIL refunds $135 within 5 business days ($15 verification fee kept, pays the verifiers), VOID restarts, REFUSED before start refunds in full.

services.name: Sponsored work item (HHC lane)
services.shape: Fund a work item escrow in HHC; settlement on gate verdict, 90% worker / 10% verifiers; sponsor row on the board.
